description: Account stat presets. 'none' uses the hero's raw Divine V base stats. 'example' overrides stats with representative total values from a well-progressed account (base + artifacts + beacon + bonds + relics combined).

none.label: Base Stats Only
none.description: Raw Divine V stats with no account bonuses applied.

example.label: With Account Stats
example.description: Total stats from a well-progressed account (base + artifacts, beacon, bonds, relics).
